title: On $\mathscr{T}$-based orthomodular dynamic algebras
summary: This paper establishes a categorical equivalence between the category $\mathbb{COL}$ of complete orthomodular lattices and the category $\mathscr{T}\mathbb{ODA}$ of $\mathscr{T}$-based orthomodular dynamic algebras. Complete orthomodular lattices serve as the static algebraic foundation for quantum logic, modeling the testable properties of quantum systems. In contrast, $\mathcal{T}$-based orthomodular dynamic algebras, which are specialized unital involutive quantales, formalize the composition and quantum-logical properties of quantum actions.
